pytest.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_scheduled_command_contracts.py tests/test_scheduler_durability.py tests/test_worker_operation_map.py tests/test_security_allowlist.py tests/test_event_bus_durability.py -q

verified_boundaries: Operation schemas match the scheduler module allowlist exactly.
Invalid commands are visible in schedule graph preflight and rejected before subprocess creation, including run-now.
Invalid runtime commands do not receive a retry deadline.
The curated job planner and static job catalog validate generated argument arrays for scheduler-allowlisted operations.
Metric verification, unbounded event workers, retention-sensitive event cleanup, operator dead-letter actions, and source-less recurring sensor ingestion are rejected.
limitations: Existing enabled scheduled_task rows are not automatically rewritten; reconcile them before candidate rollout.
The schemas do not establish tenant context, narrow database grants, or RLS safety, and do not trace transitive worker effects.
This is software test evidence only and does not certify Raspberry Pi hardware.
